summary: First round E2E testing of FormEase (FastAPI + React + Mongo). Wrote 21 pytest cases covering auth (register/login/logout/me/forgot/reset), config, full PAN wizard (draft->patch->doc upload w/ ext validation->demo order->verify->submitted), public tracking (valid & invalid), security (401/403 for cross-user, admin RBAC, unauth doc URLs), and admin panel (stats, analytics, notifications, applications list w/ filter+search, detail, doc verify/replace, add note, status change). All 21 backend tests PASS. Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright on Landing, Track, Legal, Auth, Dashboard, Apply wizard step-1 (all 6 stepper testids present), and Admin overview + Applications table. Login works with both demo customer and admin credentials via httpOnly cookies. Admin overview renders 4 charts and correct stat cards (12 apps, Rs.3,000 revenue after the tests seeded a few new apps). Payments are DEMO MODE by design; WhatsApp/email notifications are MOCKED (verified via /api/admin/notifications).

issues: Date of Birth uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn/ui Calendar component - minor UX inconsistency with premium theme

action_items: (Optional/design) Replace native <input type='date'> in Apply.jsx with a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for visual consistency.
(Cosmetic) In dev overlay, <span> is being injected inside <option> which triggers a React hydration warning on /apply/pan. Not app code but worth noting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 863 lines - consider splitting into routers/ (auth, applications, documents, payments, admin) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
seed_admin only rehashes password if it does not match, but does not re-elevate role or reset lockout counters - low priority.
Login lockout counter increments even for non-existent users (enumeration prevention via same 401 message is good), and 5-attempt lockout is enforced correctly.
bcrypt hashing verified ($2b$ format), httpOnly+secure+samesite=none cookies set, CORS uses explicit origins with credentials.
ObjectId properly excluded via serialize() helper across all endpoints - good.
All required env vars read via os.environ[...] without silent defaults - good fail-fast pattern (except a couple with defaults which is acceptable).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (Landing, Track, Legal, Auth, Dashboard, Apply step-1, Admin overview, Admin Applications table all render & interact correctly)

seed_data_creation: Test run created several new applications via API (e.g. FE-2026-00010..00016) with paid demo orders. These are safe/expected demo-mode data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. The full_pan_flow test creates a fresh customer and completes the entire wizard incl. demo payment, which the admin-detail tests then act upon (share via pytest.shared_app_id) - so run non-parallel or in order. Payments and notifications are intentionally mocked; do NOT report those as bugs.
rca of the issue: No app bugs found. Two test-only issues were self-fixed: (a) email TLD `.test` rejected by pydantic EmailStr - switched to formease.in; (b) backend lowercases emails on register so test needed to compare `email.lower()`.
